objective: Select the production Windows Desktop implementation stack from executable evidence without changing the frozen Shared Core boundary.

candidates.runtime_model: Rust desktop shell + Windows WebView2 + constrained atlas-core sidecar
Chromium/Node desktop shell + isolated main-process atlas-core child adapter
Go/WebView2 desktop shell consuming atlas-core only through stdio
.NET/C# native Windows shell + redirected atlas-core stdin/stdout

hard_gates.name: protocol-boundary
hard_gates.requirement: Spawn atlas-core --serve-stdio, complete exact protocol 1.0.0 framing/handshake, and use no FFI, direct Go import, localhost HTTP/TCP, named-pipe replacement, or hidden network fallback.

hard_gates.name: offline-operation
hard_gates.requirement: Cold start and mandatory smoke journey succeed with outbound network denied.

hard_gates.name: process-safety
hard_gates.requirement: Bounded startup and handshake timeout, crash detection, clean shutdown, orphan prevention, stderr separation, and malformed-frame containment.

hard_gates.name: core-ownership
hard_gates.requirement: Search, entity, relationship, provenance, and pack-state semantics remain exclusively owned by Shared Core.

hard_gates.name: windows-packaging
hard_gates.requirement: Reproducible Windows package/installer evidence and portable/folder-based deployment feasibility are demonstrated.

hard_gates.name: resource-evidence
hard_gates.requirement: Cold-start time, handshake time, idle working set, representative-search latency, and packaged footprint are measured on the same Windows runner class.

hard_gates.name: supply-chain
hard_gates.requirement: Exact dependency lock, SBOM, vulnerability evidence, and license inventory are available and fail closed for accepted production dependencies.

hard_gates.name: windows-ux
hard_gates.requirement: Keyboard navigation, accessibility path, DPI/scaling, and high-DPI multi-monitor feasibility are demonstrated.

hard_gates.name: security-posture
hard_gates.requirement: Renderer/webview privileges are minimized and process execution is constrained to the compiled atlas-core path and allowlisted arguments.

hard_gates.name: automation
hard_gates.requirement: Deterministic build and automatable smoke evidence runs on ATLAS-CI-WIN01 without persistent runner mutation.

hard_gates.name: release-compatibility
hard_gates.requirement: Authenticode/application and installer signing are technically compatible without selecting the final certificate/HSM/KMS provider.

hard_gates.name: maintainability
hard_gates.requirement: Implementation complexity, testability, UI iteration velocity, platform coupling, and operational maintenance are evidenced and scored.

execution_rounds.name: hard-gate micro-probes
execution_rounds.purpose: Eliminate candidates that cannot preserve the frozen protocol, offline, process-safety, supply-chain, or automation boundaries before full UI work.

execution_rounds.name: full evidence finalists
execution_rounds.purpose: Build comparable minimal desktop shells and collect packaging, resource, UX, security, signing, and maintainability evidence.
